main-section.title: Mojdeh Mansoori, PhD
content: Postdoctoral Researcher at the Section for Orofacial Pain and Jaw Function, Department of Dentistry and Oral Health, Aarhus University.

Her research focuses on early-life risk factors and multidimensional clinical characterization of painful temporomandibular disorders (TMD) and headache, using data from the Danish National Birth Cohort.

news.content: Successfully defended her PhD dissertation, "Painful temporomandibular disorders and headache in young adulthood: early-life factors and multidimensional clinical characterization," at Aarhus University.

sections.title: Current Research
content: As a Postdoctoral Researcher at Aarhus University, Mojdeh continues to work on painful temporomandibular disorders and headache, building on her PhD research within the Danish National Birth Cohort.
Her work aims to identify early-life risk factors and clinical phenotypes that can inform prevention and treatment of these conditions.
